headline: Highland Ave temporary paving, and traffic and parking changes around the Kennedy School.
summary: Officials will give an update on temporary paving on Highland Ave. The agenda also asks for a lower-priced parking permit for driveway owners and a review of school drop-off and pick-up traffic citywide.
items: Parking Director's communication on the driveway parking permit (ID 26-1090)

Resolution asking the Parking Director to discuss a lower-priced permit for vehicles with driveways that allows daytime and evening street parking but not overnight parking or parking during street cleaning or snow emergencies (ID 26-1019)
Resolution asking the Mobility Director to paint bike markings in the Elm Street bike lane across from the Kennedy School (ID 26-1424)
Resolution asking the Mobility Director to add bike racks at the Kennedy School (ID 26-1423)
Resolution asking the Parking Director to install drop-off and pick-up signs on Cherry Street across from the Kennedy School (ID 26-1422)
Order asking the Engineering Director and Public Works Commissioner for an update on Highland Ave temporary paving (ID 26-1053)
Order asking the Mobility, Engineering and Parking directors and the Police Chief to appear to review school traffic flows and enforcement during drop-off and pick-up (ID 26-0917)
